verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration and visa legal-services provider, not a software product, so reading its source under an open license is a category error for this kind of product. The GitHub mention (docs-2) refers to packaging clients' own evidence for their petitions, and the 'open guide' items are freely published advice articles, not open-source code. Neither makes the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
